title: Conclusion on Employment Termination
summary: The conclusion assesses whether the appellant's employment was terminated at the initiative of the employer, leading to a judgment in favor of the appellant.
content:
Conclusion
The critical issue in this appeal is whether there had been a termination of the employment of the appellant. The statutory right to seek a remedy depends upon there having been. This emerges from the provisions of s 170EA(1) which reads: 'A person (‘the employee’) may apply to the Court for a remedy in respect of termination of his or her employment.'
